display_title: 18-3-3 为什么支持不同能力学生混合编班

sentences.en: Picture this scene.
sentences.zh: 请想象这样一个场景。

sentences.en: It’s an English literature lesson in a UK school, and the teacher has just read an extract from Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet with a class of 15-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 这是英国一所学校的英语文学课，老师刚和一个班的15岁学生一起读了莎士比亚《罗密欧与朱丽叶》中的一段选文。

sentences.en: He’s given some of the students copies of No Fear Shakespeare, a kid-friendly translation of the original.
sentences.zh: 他给部分学生发了《轻松读莎士比亚》，这是把原著改写成便于孩子们阅读的版本。

sentences.en: For three students, even these literacy demands are beyond them.
sentences.zh: 有三个学生连这样的读写要求都达不到。

sentences.en: Another girl simply can’t focus and he gives her pens and paper to draw with.
sentences.zh: 另外一个女孩怎么也集中不了注意力，老师便给了她笔和纸，让她画画。

sentences.en: The teacher can ask the No Fear group to identify the key characters and maybe provide a tentative plot summary.
sentences.zh: 老师可以请读《轻松读莎士比亚》的那组学生找出主要人物，或许还可以让他们试着概述一下情节。

sentences.en: He can ask most of the class about character development, and five of them might be able to support their statements with textual evidence.
sentences.zh: 他可以问班上大多数学生，人物是怎样发展变化的；其中可能有五个学生能用文本证据来支持自己的说法。

sentences.en: Now two curious students are wondering whether Shakespeare advocates living a life of moderation or one of passionate engagement.
sentences.zh: 这时，两个好奇的学生正在思考，莎士比亚倡导的是有节制的人生，还是满怀热情、积极投入的人生。

sentences.en: As a teacher myself, I’d think my lesson would be going rather well if the discussion went as described above.
sentences.zh: 我自己也是教师，如果课堂讨论能像刚才描述的那样展开，我会觉得这堂课上得相当顺利。

sentences.en: But wouldn’t this kind of class work better if there weren’t such a huge gap between the top and the bottom?
sentences.zh: 可是，如果班上程度最高和最低的学生之间没有这么大的差距，这样的课不是会更有效吗？

sentences.en: If we put all the kids who needed literacy support into one class, and all the students who want to discuss the virtue of moderation into another?
sentences.zh: 要是把所有需要读写辅导的孩子放进一个班，再把所有想讨论节制这一美德的学生放进另一个班呢？

sentences.en: The practice of ‘streaming’, or ‘tracking’, involves separating students into classes depending on their diagnosed levels of attainment.
sentences.zh: 所谓按水平分班，英语称作 streaming 或 tracking，指的是按照评估所得的学业水平，把学生分到不同的班级。

sentences.en: At a macro level, it requires the establishment of academically selective schools for the brightest students, and comprehensive schools for the rest.
sentences.zh: 从宏观层面看，这种做法需要为最聪明的学生设立按学业成绩选拔的学校，并为其余学生设立综合学校。

sentences.en: Within schools, it means selecting students into a ‘stream’ of general ability, or ‘sets’ of subject-specific ability.
sentences.zh: 在学校内部，它指的是按学生的综合能力分班，或按他们在某一学科的能力分组。

sentences.en: The practice is intuitively appealing to almost every stakeholder.
sentences.zh: 凭直觉看，几乎每一个相关方都会觉得这种做法有吸引力。

sentences.en: I have heard the mixed-ability model attacked by way of analogy: a group hike.
sentences.zh: 我听过有人用集体徒步打比方，批评不同能力学生混合编班的做法。

sentences.en: The fittest in the group take the lead and set a brisk pace, only to have to stop and wait every 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 体力最好的人走在队伍前面，把步速带得很快，结果每隔二十分钟就不得不停下来等别人。

sentences.en: This is frustrating, and their enthusiasm wanes.
sentences.zh: 这让他们感到沮丧，热情也慢慢消退了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the slowest ones are not only embarrassed but physically struggling to keep up.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，走得最慢的人不仅觉得难堪，体力上也很难跟上。

sentences.en: What’s worse, they never get a long enough break.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，他们始终得不到足够长的休息时间。

sentences.en: They honestly just want to quit.
sentences.zh: 说实话，他们只想退出。

sentences.en: Hiking, they feel, is not for them.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得，徒步并不适合自己。

sentences.en: Mixed-ability classes bore students, frustrate parents and burn out teachers.
sentences.zh: 不同能力学生混合编班，会让学生感到无聊，让家长感到挫败，也会让教师精疲力竭。

sentences.en: The brightest ones will never summit Mount Qomolangma, and the stragglers won’t enjoy the lovely stroll in the park they are perhaps more suited to.
sentences.zh: 最聪明的学生永远也登不上珠穆朗玛峰；而跟在后面的学生，本来可能更适合在公园里悠闲漫步，却也享受不到这样的乐趣。

sentences.en: Individuals suffer at the demands of the collective, mediocrity prevails.
sentences.zh: 个体为满足集体的要求而受苦，平庸成了常态。

sentences.en: So: is learning like hiking?
sentences.zh: 那么，学习真的和徒步一样吗？

sentences.en: The current pedagogical paradigm is arguably that of constructivism, which emerged out of the work of psychologist Lev Vygotsky.
sentences.zh: 当下主流的教学范式可以说是建构主义，它源自心理学家列夫·维果茨基的学术研究。

sentences.en: In the 1930s, Vygotsky emphasised the importance of targeting a student’s specific ‘zone of proximal development’ (ZPD).
sentences.zh: 20世纪30年代，维果茨基强调，教学应针对每个学生特有的“最近发展区”（ZPD）。

sentences.en: This is the gap between what they can achieve only with support — teachers, textbooks, worked examples, parents and so on — and what they can achieve independently.
sentences.zh: 这是学生在教师、课本、解题示例、家长等的支持下才能做到的事，与他们能独立做到的事之间的差距。

sentences.en: The purpose of teaching is to provide and then gradually remove this ‘scaffolding’ until they are autonomous.
sentences.zh: 教学的目的，就是先提供这样的“支架”，再逐步撤去，直到学生能够自主学习。

sentences.en: If we accept this model, it follows that streaming students with similar ZPDs would be an efficient and effective solution.
sentences.zh: 如果接受这一模型，自然可以推论，把最近发展区相近的学生分到一班，会是一种既高效又有效的办法。

sentences.en: And that forcing everyone on the same hike — regardless of aptitude — would be madness.
sentences.zh: 按这个逻辑，不顾各人的天资，硬要大家走同一条徒步路线，简直就是荒唐。

sentences.en: Despite all this, there is limited empirical evidence to suggest that streaming results in better outcomes for students.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，能表明按能力分班有助于学生取得更好成绩的实证证据十分有限。

sentences.en: Professor John Hattie, director of the Melbourne Education Research Institute, notes that ‘tracking has minimal effects on learning outcomes’.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本教育研究院院长约翰·哈蒂教授指出，“按能力分班对学习成果的影响微乎其微”。

sentences.en: What is more, streaming appears to significantly — and negatively — affect those students assigned to the lowest sets.
sentences.zh: 此外，按能力分班似乎会对那些被分进最低层次组别的学生产生显著的负面影响。

sentences.en: These students tend to have much higher representation of low socioeconomic class.
sentences.zh: 这些学生当中，社会经济地位较低者所占的比例往往高得多。

sentences.en: Less significant is the small benefit for those lucky clever students in the higher sets.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，那些被分到高水平组、既幸运又聪明的学生所得的好处很小，并不那么显著。

sentences.en: The overall result is that the smart stay smart and the dumb get dumber, further entrenching the social divide.
sentences.zh: 总的结果是，聪明的学生依然聪明，笨的学生却越来越笨，社会分化也由此进一步固化。

sentences.en: In the latest update of Hattie’s influential meta-analysis of factors influencing student achievement, one of the most significant factors is the teachers’ estimate of achievement.
sentences.zh: 哈蒂曾对影响学生成就的因素进行了一项很有影响力的元分析。在最新的更新中，最重要的因素之一是教师对学生成绩的预估。

sentences.en: Streaming students by diagnosed achievement automatically limits what the teacher feels the student is capable of.
sentences.zh: 按评估所得的成绩给学生分班，自然会限制教师对学生能力的预期。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in a mixed environment, teachers’ estimates need to be more diverse and flexible.
sentences.zh: 而在不同能力学生混合学习的环境中，教师的预期需要更多样，也更灵活。

sentences.en: While streaming might seem to help teachers effectively target a student’s ZPD, it can underestimate the importance of peer-to-peer learning.
sentences.zh: 按能力分班看似有助于教师有效地针对学生的最近发展区开展教学，却可能低估同伴互学的重要性。

sentences.en: A crucial aspect of constructivist theory is the role of the MKO — ‘more knowledgeable other’ — in knowledge construction.
sentences.zh: 建构主义理论有一个关键方面，即“更有知识的他人”（MKO）在知识建构中发挥的作用。

sentences.en: While teachers are traditionally the MKOs in classrooms, the value of knowledgeable student peers must not go unrecognised either.
sentences.zh: 在传统课堂上，教师通常担当这种角色，但知识较丰富的学生同伴也有其价值，同样不能忽视。

sentences.en: I find it amazing to watch students get over an idea to their peers in ways that I would never think of.
sentences.zh: 看到学生用我怎么也想不到的方式把一个想法讲给同伴听，我觉得很了不起。

sentences.en: They operate with different language tools and different social tools from teachers and, having just learnt it themselves, they possess similar cognitive structures to their struggling classmates.
sentences.zh: 他们运用的语言工具和社交手段与教师不同；又因为自己也刚学会，他们的认知结构与那些仍感吃力的同学很相似。

sentences.en: There is also something exciting about passing on skills and knowledge that you yourself have just mastered — a certain pride and zeal, a certain freshness to the interaction between ‘teacher’ and ‘learner’ that is often lost by the expert for whom the steps are obvious and the joy of discovery forgotten.
sentences.zh: 把自己刚掌握的技能和知识传给别人，本身也令人兴奋。“老师”与“学生”互动时，有一种自豪、一股热情，也有一分新鲜感；而专家对每一步都已了然于心，也早已忘了发现新知时的喜悦，往往失去了这种感受。

sentences.en: Having a variety of different abilities in a collaborative learning environment provides valuable resources for helping students meet their learning needs, not to mention improving their communication and social skills.
sentences.zh: 在合作学习的环境中，不同能力的学生齐聚一堂，为满足学生的学习需要提供了宝贵资源，更不用说还能提高他们的沟通能力和社交技能。

sentences.en: And today, more than ever, we need the many to flourish — not suffer at the expense of a few bright stars.
sentences.zh: 如今，我们比以往任何时候都更需要让大多数学生蓬勃成长，不能为了少数几个耀眼的学生，就让大多数人吃亏。

sentences.en: Once a year, I go on a hike with my class, a mixed bunch of students.
sentences.zh: 我每年都会带班上的学生徒步一次；这是一个由不同能力学生组成的班级。

sentences.en: It is challenging.
sentences.zh: 这颇有挑战。

sentences.en: The fittest students realise they need to encourage the reluctant.
sentences.zh: 体力最好的学生会意识到，他们得鼓励那些不太愿意走的同学。

sentences.en: There are lookouts who report back, and extra items to carry for others.
sentences.zh: 有人到前面探路再回来报告，也有人需要帮别人多带些东西。

sentences.en: We make it — together.
sentences.zh: 我们成功走完了全程，是大家一起做到的。
